description: Repairs r-sql-13b/memo-compare-scope: the 48-row cap cut off the pair list. Asks which Memo pairs match, as counts so that no row cap applies: MMP holds pairs of Memo values equal up to position p and different at p ('a' versus 'b') for p = 250, 254, 255, 256, 257, 300, 1000 plus a repeat of row 1; Count(*) of pairs (a.id < b.id) with a.m = b.m as INNER JOIN and as comma join, with a.m < b.m, and both grouped by a.p and b.p. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE MMP (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_MMP PRIMARY KEY, p LONG, m MEMO)
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM MMP
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM MMP AS a INNER JOIN MMP AS b ON a.m = b.m WHERE a.id < b.id
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM MMP AS a, MMP AS b WHERE a.m = b.m AND a.id < b.id
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM MMP AS a, MMP AS b WHERE a.m < b.m AND a.id < b.id
SELECT a.p AS pa, b.p AS pb, Count(*) AS n FROM MMP AS a, MMP AS b WHERE a.m = b.m AND a.id < b.id GROUP BY a.p, b.p ORDER BY a.p, b.p
SELECT a.p AS pa, b.p AS pb, Count(*) AS n FROM MMP AS a, MMP AS b WHERE a.m < b.m AND a.id < b.id GROUP BY a.p, b.p ORDER BY a.p, b.p
